summary: Frontend-only E2E for ROYAL11 AUTH UX (password reveal, remember-me, forgot-password + reset) across both player app ('/') and staff console ('/console/login'). ALL 11 planned test points PASSED. No frontend or backend issues found.

critical_code_review_comments: Auth flow is well-implemented: httpOnly usage via AuthContext, remember_me plumbed through, ForgotPasswordDialog properly reused between AuthPage and ConsoleLoginPage.
Anti-enumeration correctly implemented: backend returns generic success message and dialog always advances to reset step regardless of email existence.
Client-side password mismatch guard fires BEFORE API call (good UX + protects against wasted OTP attempts).
Both password toggles (auth-password-input and forgot-newpass-input) work as expected and have proper aria-labels.

Minor observation (non-blocking): ForgotPasswordDialog's `show` state toggles BOTH newpass and confirm fields together (both bound to same `type={show ? 'text' : 'password'}`). This is expected UX but only the newpass field has a visible eye icon; the confirm field silently follows. Acceptable, but a subtle behavior.

context_for_next_testing_agent: All auth UX features from the review request are fully functional. PWRESET_OTP_DEBUG log lines are emitted to /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log with format 'PWRESET_OTP_DEBUG <email> -> <code>' (OTP_DEBUG_LOG=true is enabled). The double-reset-to-restore pattern is a reliable way to E2E test forgot-pw without needing a throwaway account.
